vars.label: 흐른 날
vars.desc: Days that passed in this response. Next morning = 1, three days later = 3. Leave 0 while the scene stays within the same day — the date and every day-counted timer move only with this.

vars.label: 위치
vars.desc: Where the scene is. Inside a Gate write "게이트 내부 — <던전 이름>".

vars.label: 레벨
vars.desc: 시스템이 올린다 (EXP가 차면 자동 레벨업). 직접 바꾸지 마라.

vars.label: EXP
vars.desc: EXP earned this turn from monster kills, quest completion, training. Write the GAIN only — level-ups are handled by the system, never touch level yourself. Typical kills: E-rank monster 10~30, D 40~80, C 100~200. No evidence in the scene = no EXP.

vars.label: 스탯 포인트
vars.desc: Unspent points (+2 per level-up, system-granted). Spend ONLY when the narrative says training/allocation happened: lower this and raise the matching stat by the same amount.

vars.label: 근력
vars.desc: Raise only by spending stat_pts (same amount down there) or explicit narrative growth.

vars.label: 체질
vars.desc: Same rule as str. Max HP = CON×10.

vars.label: 민첩
vars.desc: Same rule as str. Max SP = AGI×10.

vars.label: 지능
vars.desc: Same rule as str. Max MP = INT×10.

vars.label: 감각
vars.desc: Same rule as str.

vars.label: HP
vars.desc: Life. 0 = incapacitated. Damage taken and healing, as the narrative shows. Cap = CON×10 (system clamps).

vars.label: MP
vars.desc: Mana. Skill/magic use drains it; rest and potions restore. Below 30% = severe strain, casting may fail.

vars.label: SP
vars.desc: Stamina. Exertion and physical skills drain it; light movement does not. Below 30% = severe strain.

vars.label: 헌터 라이선스
vars.desc: Association-certified rank. Change ONLY when the narrative completes an official evaluation/promotion — raw power growth alone does not move this.

vars.label: 클래스
vars.desc: Class name with disclosure rank, e.g. "궁수 (일반)", "저승 무사 (히든)". 없음 if none.

vars.label: 소속
vars.desc: Guild/team/agency the hunter belongs to. 무소속 if none.

vars.label: 명성
vars.desc: How known the hunter is in hunter society and on HunterNet. Rises with public feats, falls with scandals. A rookie stays under 10 for a long while.

vars.label: 무기
vars.desc: Equipped weapons, max 2 — "철제 활 (일반)". Swap = remove old + add new. Stored gear goes to items.

vars.label: 장신구
vars.desc: Equipped accessories, max 2, same format as weapons.

vars.label: 방어구
vars.desc: Equipped armor — "강화 전술복 (일반)". 없음 if none.

vars.label: 소지품
vars.desc: Carried items with count LAST — "하급 회복 포션 3", "고블린 마정석 5". Consuming/looting updates the count (remove old entry, add updated one). Money is NOT an item.

vars.label: 스킬
vars.desc: Learned skills, name only — no numbers. Skills come from skill books, training, Awakening moments.

vars.label: 퀘스트
vars.desc: Active quests — "제목 — 목표 (보상)". No progress numbers inside; narrate progress instead. Remove on completion/failure. A deadline may be tagged "@+days" — the system expires it.

vars.label: 원화
vars.desc: Korean won. Income needs on-screen evidence (quest payout, sale, salary) — never invent it. Spending follows real-world prices; hunter gear runs millions.

vars.label: 코인
vars.desc: Alter Store currency (only meaningful while the store exists in this run). Earned from monster kills and quest completion, small amounts (E-rank kill: 1~5).

vars.label: (내부) 전투불능
vars.desc: 시스템 래치 — HP 0 이벤트가 세운다. 직접 바꾸지 마라.

vars.label: (내부) 승급 알림
vars.desc: 시스템 래치. 직접 바꾸지 마라.

vars.label: 알터 스토어
vars.desc: 유저 정책값 (원본 lore 토글). 켜면 코인·알터 스토어 서사가 활성. 시작 후 바꾸려면 /스토어.

vars.label: 적대 세력
vars.desc: 유저 정책값 (원본 faction 토글). 불신론자·이계 숭배단 서사 축.

vars.label: 액션 서사
vars.desc: 유저 정책값 (원본 scenario 토글). 끄면 일상물 — 게이트 이벤트 빈도가 내려간다.

vars.label: 위험도
vars.desc: 세계의 흉흉함 — 프리셋이 정하고 P3 게이트 빈도·이벤트 문턱이 읽는다. 직접 바꾸지 마라.

vars.label: (내부) 지난 정산일
vars.desc: 시스템 전용 — 일 단위 카운트다운의 거울 변수. 직접 바꾸지 마라.

vars.label: (내부) 최근 출현 권역
vars.desc: 시스템이 굴린다 (0=없음). 직접 바꾸지 마라.

vars.label: (내부) 최근 출현 등급
vars.desc: 시스템이 굴린다 (0=없음). 직접 바꾸지 마라.

vars.label: 게이트 보드
vars.desc: Association board of open Gates — "권역 등급 이름 @+잔여일", e.g. "동북권 D 고블린 소굴 @+6". Register a gate when a [게이트] notice or the narrative establishes one; remove when cleared. A gate whose deadline lapses disappears — other hunters cleared it off-screen, or it closed.

vars.label: 브레이크 경보
vars.desc: THE one gate whose break the story is racing against; empty if none. ALWAYS set break_in (days left) in the same turn you set this.

vars.label: 브레이크까지
vars.desc: Days until that gate breaks. The system counts it down; at 0 the break fires. Set only at the start.

vars.label: 게이트 안
vars.desc: true while the protagonist is INSIDE a Gate/dungeon (communications cut). Set back to false the moment they exit.

vars.label: 인물 변동
vars.desc: Lasting CHANGES to named NPCs only — promotion, guild move, notable new gear/skill, grave injury, death. Format "이름 — 변화", e.g. "김민수 — D급 승급", "서지한 — 흡혈 저주 해제". Profiles are the baseline; log deviations only, one entry per fact, replace when superseded. NOT for moods, locations or the protagonist.

events.notify: [시스템] 레벨 업 — 스탯 포인트 +2. 본문에 `[시스템] 레벨 업!` 한 줄로 짧게 연출하라. 포인트 분배는 유저의 몫이니 마음대로 분배하지 마라.
HP가 0이 됐다 — 전투불능이다. 의식을 잃거나 몸을 가눌 수 없는 상태를 서사에 반영하라. 죽음으로 확정하지는 마라 (구조·응급처치의 여지는 서사가 정한다).
의식이 돌아왔다 — 회복의 순간을 서사에 반영하라.

events.when: est_n > lic_n and lic_n >= 1 and not promo_seen
events.notify: 측정 수치가 현재 라이선스 등급 구간을 넘어섰다. 협회 재측정(승급 심사)을 받을 자격이 생겼다 — 주변 인물이나 협회 단말 알림으로 자연스럽게 흘려라. 심사 없이 등급이 바뀌지는 않는다.

[게이트 브레이크] The watched gate's deadline has passed — monsters pour into the city. This is a district-scale disaster: sirens, evacuation, hunter mobilization. The protagonist need not be at the epicenter, but the world must feel it. Remove that gate from the board.

table.notify: [게이트] A new Gate has appeared — district and grade are in the state block (최근 출현). Weave it in naturally: association alert on the terminal, HunterNet buzz, or a distant siren. Name it and register it on the gates board with a deadline (@+days).
[대형 사태] An S-Grade Gate has formed — national-news scale. Top guilds and the Association scramble; ordinary hunters are ordered to perimeter duty. Register it on the board.
[던전 이변] Seed an anomaly for the NEXT dungeon run — a hidden room, a second-layer entrance, an out-of-place relic, or monsters behaving wrong. Foreshadow now; pay off inside.
[돌발 퀘스트] A quest arises from the current situation — new objective, challenge or opportunity the party may pursue. Announce it as a system quest and add it to the quest list.
[스카웃] A guild or agency has noticed the protagonist — an approach with concrete terms. Pick a plausible one from the cast/guilds; accepting or refusing both carry consequences.
[협회] The Hunter Association contacts the protagonist — commissioned subjugation, measurement follow-up, paperwork, or a favor with strings attached.
[암시장] A Black Market thread surfaces — a fence, an unregistered item, a coin-hungry broker. Tempting, illegal, and remembered by the wrong people.
[헌터넷] Something about the protagonist is trending on HunterNet — clip, rumor or witness thread. Public opinion cuts both ways.
[불온한 기척] Signs of PK or hostile-faction activity near the protagonist's routes — a party that never came back, a tail, a too-friendly stranger. Build dread, no ambush yet.
[기연] A chance at growth appears — a skill book drop, a master's passing advice, or an awakening trigger under pressure. It must be earned in the scene, not given.

[인물] Introduce an NPC who fits the current scene naturally — support, information, or a quest hook. Prefer the registered cast in the current rank band; a fresh face is allowed. Not while the protagonist is in lodging, private space, or intimacy.
[의외의 인물] Introduce someone who does NOT fit the scene — wrong place, wrong rank, wrong manner. Their presence itself is a question the story should answer later.
[적대적 인물] Introduce or surface an antagonist — rival hunter, saboteur, or a hostile faction contact. Menace through behavior, not immediate violence.
[반전] Reveal that something established was not what it seemed — an ally's motive, a quest's true client, an item's origin. Twist facts, never retcon them.
[어려운 결정] Force a dilemma with no clean answer — save one or the other, profit or principle, speed or safety. Lay out stakes clearly and let the user choose.
[비밀 발견] The protagonist stumbles onto something hidden — a document, an overheard conversation, a gate anomaly. Knowing it is a burden as much as an asset.
[행운] A small good thing happens — a generous payout, a rare drop, unexpected kindness. Keep it proportionate; the world stays tough.
[악재] Something goes wrong — gear breaks, a payment is delayed, a rumor sours, weather turns. A complication, not a catastrophe.
[여파] A consequence of a PAST scene arrives now — gratitude, a grudge, a bill, a summons. Pull from what actually happened in this story.
[관계] Deepen a relationship already on screen — a meal, a favor repaid, a quiet conversation that shifts how two people see each other.
[자아] Give the protagonist a beat of self-discovery — why they hunt, what they fear, what the Awakening changed. Interior, quiet, earned.

directives.text: "측정 불가" 판정을 남발하지 마라 — 미지의 존재라도 대부분 S 구간 안에서 수치화된다. 수치·랭크의 최종 근거는 상태 블록이다.
주인공은 전투불능 상태다 — 스스로 움직일 수 없다. 자력 탈출·반격을 묘사하지 마라.
HP가 30% 아래다 — 중상이다. 통증·출혈·움직임 제약이 서사에 배어야 한다.

directives.when: (mp <= mp_max * 3 / 10 or sp <= sp_max * 3 / 10) and hp > hp_max * 3 / 10
directives.text: MP 또는 SP가 30% 아래다 — 극심한 소모 상태. 격한 행동·시전은 실패하거나 대가를 치른다.
수중에 돈이 한 푼도 없다 — 결제·구매가 필요한 장면은 그 사실에 부딪혀야 한다.
미분배 스탯 포인트가 {stat_pts}점 쌓여 있다. 분배는 유저의 선택이다 — 대신 정하지 말고, 수련·정비 장면에서 가볍게 상기시켜라.

Seoul hunter administration divides the city into 5 zones: 도심권(종로·중구·용산) · 동북권(성북·노원·강북) · 서북권(은평·서대문·마포) · 서남권(양천·구로·영등포·관악) · 동남권(서초·강남·송파·강동). Gate notices and the gates board use these zone names.
브레이크 임박 — "{break_name}"이(가) {break_in}일 안에 터진다. 도시의 긴장(대피 안내, 헌터 소집, 헌터넷 술렁임)이 배경에 깔려야 한다.
일상물 페이스다 — 전투·게이트 서사를 앞세우지 말고 생활·관계·직업의 결을 그려라.

This world has the Alter Store — an ethereal system shop only the Awakened can open (a translucent interface, summoned at will outside Gates). It trades in Coin, not money. Purchases and sales are handled by the store panel; the [알터 스토어] notices in events are settled facts. Non-hunters cannot see or use it.

The named cast listed below are this world's recurring figures. Introduce naturally only those whose rank band fits the scene; the rest exist off-screen unless an event, reputation or the user pulls them in. Anyone already in the story stays available regardless of band. If a [인물 변동] entry exists for someone, it overrides their profile baseline.

updater.guide: 헌터물 기록 기준: 게이트 안 전투가 있었으면 그 턴에 HP/MP/SP 소모·소모품 사용·전리품(마정석 등 items)·EXP를 함께 정산하라. 근거 없는 수입·EXP는 적지 마라. 시간(skip_day)은 날짜가 실제로 넘어갔을 때만. 스탯은 stat_pts를 소모하는 분배 장면에서만 올린다.

promptState.systemGuide: 이 세계는 시스템 창이 뜨는 세계다 — 레벨업·스킬 습득·퀘스트 발생 같은 시스템 사건은 본문 문단 사이 `[시스템] …` 한 줄로 짧게 연출하라. 수치 정산은 상태 블록의 몫이니 숫자를 본문에 나열하지 마라.

board.label: 헌터넷
board.topics: 게이트 출현·공략 소식, 헌터 목격담과 소문, 장비·마정석 시세, 협회/길드 뒷말, 랭크 측정 후기, 몬스터 정보 공유, 각성 관련 잡담
board.guide: Anonymous hunter forum in Korean internet-community register: 반말, 마침표 생략, 축약·밈·드립, 낚시글과 헛소문 섞임. 닉네임은 짧은 한국어 (예: ㅇㅇ, 각성실패자, 노원구주민, 창술만12년). 글이 다 진실일 필요 없다 — 과장·유언비어·광고성 글도 게시판의 결이다. Posts reference the current gates board, recent public events, and famous hunters.

shop.label: 알터 스토어
shop.guide: Coin economy baseline: an E-rank monster kill pays 1~5 Coin — price everything relative to that. Practical hunter goods (potions, whetstones, antidotes, mana crystals, skill books, gear). 추천/인기 are curation shelves — reuse items from other categories with a hook. Occasional 한정 상품 (qty). The store never sells Legendary anything.
